shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v '.agents/' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx; echo ----; cat src/main.tsx; echo ----; cat src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ----; cat index.html; echo ----; cat AGENTS.md; echo ----; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name "ThemeProvider*.d.ts" | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ----; ls $U/build/esm/components/theme/; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; grep -n -i "theme" $U/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat $U/build/esm/components/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----; ls $U/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/Radio/SegmentedRadioGroup/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $U -path "*SegmentedRadioGroup*" -name "*.d.ts" | head; echo ----; find $U -name "SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts" -o -name "types.d.ts" -path "*Segmented*" | head; echo ----; cat $(find $U -name "SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts" | head -1); echo ----; grep -rn "SegmentedRadioGroup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -5

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n -C 12 "SegmentedRadioGroup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; rg -n -i "required setup" -A 12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -30

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls $U/layout; cat $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30
rm -rf dist && ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom)$"; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(vitest|tsx)$"; node -v
